title: Thank you for installing MultiPost
subtitle: Your one-click solution for multi-platform content publishing

instructions.step1: 1. Click the extension icon in your browser's toolbar
instructions.step2: 2. Pin the extension to keep it easily accessible

multiPlatform.title: Multi-Platform Support
multiPlatform.description: Publish your content to over 10 mainstream platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, and more with just one click.

noLogin.title: No Login Required
noLogin.description: Start publishing immediately - no registration, no API keys, and completely free to use.

integration.title: Easy Integration
integration.description: Supports web page integration and automation features like scheduled posting and AI content generation.
